about.whatTitle: A marketplace built around discovery, timing, and value shaped by real demand.
whatParagraphs: Relora brings together buyers, collectors, enthusiasts, and sellers in a refined online auction environment. It is designed for discovering items that feel special - pieces with character, rarity, and lasting appeal.

Instead of endless mass-produced inventory, Relora focuses on items that stand out. From designer clothing and archive fashion to unique lifestyle objects and collectible finds, the goal is to create a marketplace that feels more intentional from the start.

The platform combines the excitement of live bidding with the clarity of modern e-commerce. It is not only about buying quickly - it is about discovery, timing, and value revealed through real interest.
about.audienceTitle: For buyers, collectors, fashion enthusiasts, and sellers who care about the right environment.
audienceParagraphs: Relora is built for people who want more than ordinary shopping experiences. It is made for those looking for rare wardrobe pieces, standout accessories, collectible objects, and a marketplace that feels calmer and more deliberate.
It is also for sellers who want their items to be seen properly - not buried inside noise, but presented in a cleaner setting where quality and individuality matter more.
about.discoverTitle: Designer fashion, archive clothing, accessories, footwear, bags, and collectible objects worth noticing.
discoverParagraphs: The marketplace is intended to feature categories such as designer fashion, archive clothing, accessories, footwear, bags, lifestyle objects, and other collectible items that deserve attention.
The focus stays on pieces that feel curated rather than generic - items chosen for their design, rarity, identity, or cultural relevance.
about.auctionsTitle: Auctions create a different relationship between buyer, seller, and item.
about.auctionsDescription: Instead of simply scrolling and checking out, users participate in a process where value is discovered over time. For sellers, auctions create visibility and the possibility of reaching true market value. For buyers, they create anticipation, competition, and a stronger sense of reward.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know about buying, selling, auctions, shipping, payments, returns, and authenticity on Relora - the curated marketplace for designer fashion, archive clothing, luxury streetwear, vintage garments, and collectible fashion pieces.

1.question: What is Relora?
paragraphs: Relora is a curated marketplace dedicated to designer fashion, archive clothing, luxury streetwear, vintage fashion, and rare collectible garments.

The platform allows users to buy and sell designer pieces from brands such as Rick Owens, Raf Simons, Balenciaga, Vetements, Helmut Lang, Number (N)ine, Undercover, Chrome Hearts, Maison Margiela, Yohji Yamamoto, and many more.
Unlike traditional marketplaces, Relora focuses on fashion culture, curated listings, cleaner browsing, and a premium user experience.

2.question: What can I sell on Relora?
paragraphs: Users can sell designer clothing, archive fashion, luxury streetwear, vintage garments, sneakers, bags, accessories, runway pieces, collectible fashion items, and rare clothing.
Popular categories include designer jackets, hoodies, denim, footwear, luxury accessories, runway archive pieces, and limited edition collections.
Counterfeit products, replica items, and misleading listings are prohibited.

3.question: How do I create a listing?
paragraphs: Sellers can create listings by uploading product photos, entering item details, selecting category information, and setting a price or auction configuration.
Accurate descriptions, measurements, condition details, and clear product photos help improve buyer trust and increase sales potential.
Some listings may go through moderation before becoming publicly visible on the marketplace.

4.question: How do auctions work?
paragraphs: Sellers can start timed auctions for eligible fashion items. Buyers place bids during the auction period, and the highest bid at the end of the auction wins.
Auctions are especially useful for rare archive fashion, collectible designer garments, and difficult-to-price items.
Auction duration and availability may vary depending on seller settings and marketplace rules.

5.question: How does Relora handle authenticity?
paragraphs: Relora aims to reduce counterfeit listings through moderation, seller monitoring, detailed product requirements, and manual review systems.
Buyers should carefully inspect product photos, labels, stitching, hardware, tags, and condition details before purchasing luxury fashion or designer clothing.
Listings suspected of violating authenticity standards may be removed, hidden, or manually reviewed.

6.question: What condition should items be in?
paragraphs: Sellers should accurately describe item condition, including any flaws, signs of wear, discoloration, repairs, stains, or alterations.
Transparency helps buyers make informed purchasing decisions and reduces disputes related to item condition.
Archive and vintage fashion may naturally contain signs of age, which should always be clearly disclosed in the listing.

7.question: Does Relora support worldwide shipping?
paragraphs: Many sellers on Relora offer international shipping for luxury fashion, archive clothing, and designer garments.
Shipping costs, delivery times, customs fees, and import taxes may vary depending on destination country and shipping provider.
Buyers should review shipping details before completing a purchase.

8.question: What payment methods are supported?
paragraphs: Payment methods may vary depending on region, seller configuration, and platform integrations.
Relora continues to expand secure payment support to improve the buying and selling experience for fashion enthusiasts, collectors, and luxury consumers.
Buyers should always confirm order details before completing payment.

9.question: Can I return an item?
paragraphs: Return eligibility depends on seller policies, item condition, authenticity concerns, and dispute review outcomes.
Buyers are encouraged to carefully review all listing details, photos, measurements, and descriptions before purchasing designer clothing or archive fashion pieces.
Items significantly different from their description may qualify for dispute review.

10.question: What happens if there is a dispute?
paragraphs: Relora is developing dispute handling systems to assist buyers and sellers with issues related to delivery, authenticity, damaged items, or incorrect product descriptions.
Buyers and sellers should keep shipping proof, tracking information, communication records, and detailed product photos whenever possible.
Fraudulent activity, abuse of refunds, or dishonest behavior may result in account restrictions or removal from the platform.

11.question: Why should I use Relora instead of other marketplaces?
paragraphs: Relora focuses on curated designer fashion instead of overwhelming users with low-quality mass-market listings.
The platform is designed specifically for archive fashion, luxury clothing, collectible garments, designer auctions, vintage fashion, and fashion culture communities.
Cleaner browsing, premium listings, fashion-focused categories, and auction functionality help create a more specialized marketplace experience.

12.question: Is Relora free to use?
paragraphs: Browsing the marketplace is free. Selling fees, premium features, commissions, or optional marketplace tools may vary as the platform evolves.
Relora continuously improves marketplace infrastructure, moderation systems, seller tools, and auction functionality to support long-term growth.

13.question: How can I improve my chances of selling?
paragraphs: High-quality product photos, accurate descriptions, transparent condition details, measurements, and competitive pricing help improve listing performance.
Archive fashion buyers often search for specific collections, runway seasons, rare garments, and hard-to-find designer pieces.
Detailed listings help build trust and improve visibility within the marketplace.

14.question: Are fake or replica items allowed?
paragraphs: No. Counterfeit products, replicas, fake designer items, and misleading listings are prohibited on Relora.
Sellers attempting to distribute counterfeit fashion products may face listing removal, account suspension, or permanent marketplace bans.

15.question: Is Relora focused only on luxury fashion?
paragraphs: Relora primarily focuses on designer fashion, archive collections, luxury streetwear, avant-garde fashion, and collectible garments.
However, the platform also welcomes quality fashion pieces that align with the marketplace aesthetic and community interests.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.description: These Terms of Service govern your access to and use of the Relora platform, including browsing, listing items, bidding, and completing transactions.
terms.summary: By using Relora, you agree to follow the platform rules, provide accurate information, and respect the auction process, payment obligations, and listing standards.
terms.footerText: Clear rules support a cleaner marketplace.

1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
content: By accessing or using Relora, you agree to be bound by these Terms. If you do not agree, you should not use the platform.

2.title: 2. User Accounts
content: You may be required to create an account to access certain features. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials.
You agree to provide accurate and complete information and to keep it updated.

3.title: 3. Auctions and Bidding
content: Relora operates as an auction-based marketplace where users can list items and place bids.
By placing a bid, you agree that your bid is binding and that you intend to purchase the item if your bid is the highest at the end of the auction.
Sellers are responsible for accurately describing items, including condition, authenticity, and details.

4.title: 4. Transactions
content: When an auction ends, the highest bidder is obligated to complete the transaction.
Payment and delivery terms may depend on the platform's policies and integrations with payment providers.
Relora may act as an intermediary but is not the direct seller of listed items.

5.title: 5. Fees and Payments
content: Certain features or transactions may be subject to fees. These fees will be clearly communicated before they apply.
Relora reserves the right to update pricing and fee structures at any time.

Manipulating bids or engaging in fraudulent behavior
Misrepresenting items or providing false information
Using the platform for unlawful purposes

7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
content: Relora provides the platform "as is" and does not guarantee the accuracy of listings, the behavior of users, or the outcome of transactions.
To the maximum extent permitted by law, Relora is not liable for any direct or indirect damages.

8.title: 8. Account Suspension and Termination
content: Relora reserves the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms or engage in harmful or abusive behavior.

9.title: 9. Changes to Terms
content: We may update these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the platform after updates constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: This Privacy Policy explains how Relora collects, uses, stores, and protects personal information when you use our platform, including browsing auctions, creating an account, listing items, placing bids, or communicating with us.
privacy.summary: We collect and use personal information to operate accounts, auctions, transactions, platform security, and support. We do not sell personal information.
privacy.footerText: Clear privacy standards support a more trustworthy marketplace.

sections.title: 1. Introduction
content: Relora respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data. We aim to process personal information in a transparent, lawful, and secure manner.
By using our platform, you acknowledge that your information may be collected and used in accordance with this Privacy Policy.

sections.title: 2. Information we collect
sections.intro: We may collect the following categories of information:
list: Account information, such as name, email address, username, and password
Profile information that you choose to provide
Transaction and auction activity, including bids, listings, purchases, and sales
Communication data, such as messages sent through the platform or support requests
Technical data, such as IP address, browser type, device information, and usage activity
Payment-related information, where applicable, processed through secure payment providers

sections.title: 3. How we use your information
sections.intro: Your information may be used to:
list: Create and manage your account
Operate auctions, listings, bidding, and transactions
Provide customer support and respond to inquiries
Improve platform functionality, performance, and security
Prevent fraud, abuse, unauthorized access, and policy violations
Send important service-related notifications
Comply with applicable legal and regulatory obligations

sections.title: 4. Legal basis for processing
content: Where applicable, we process personal data based on one or more of the following legal grounds: performance of a contract, compliance with legal obligations, legitimate interests, or your consent where consent is required.

sections.title: 5. How we share information
sections.intro: We do not sell personal information. We may share information only when necessary, including:
list: With service providers who support platform operations
With payment processors and related financial service providers
With legal authorities when required by law or to protect legal rights
In connection with business changes such as a merger, acquisition, or restructuring

sections.title: 6. Cookies and similar technologies
content: Relora may use cookies and similar technologies to improve user experience, remember preferences, analyze traffic, and maintain platform security.
You may be able to control certain cookie settings through your browser.

sections.title: 7. Data retention
content: We retain personal information only for as long as necessary to provide our services, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, enforce agreements, and maintain legitimate business records.

sections.title: 8. Data security
content: We take reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect personal information against unauthorized access, loss, misuse, disclosure, or alteration.
However, no online system can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

sections.title: 9. Your rights
content: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have rights related to your personal data, including the right to access, correct, delete, restrict, or object to certain processing activities.
You may also have the right to withdraw consent where processing is based on consent.

sections.title: 10. Third-party services and links
content: Our platform may contain links to third-party services or rely on external providers. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of third-party websites or services.

sections.title: 11. Children’s privacy
content: Relora is not intended for children, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children without an appropriate legal basis or parental authorization where required by law.

sections.title: 12. Changes to this Privacy Policy
content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our services, legal obligations, or operational practices.
The updated version will be published on this page with a revised “Last updated” date.

sections.title: 13. Contact us
content: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or how your personal information is handled, you can contact us through the platform’s support channels or by email.

buyerProtection.title: Buyer Protection
buyerProtection.description: Shop premium and archival fashion with greater confidence. Eligible purchases are protected when the payment and order process are completed through Relora.
buyerProtection.summary: Pay through Relora, receive tracked delivery and inspect your order within 48 hours. Report serious problems before the protection period expires.

steps.title: Pay through Relora
steps.description: Complete the payment through Relora after winning an auction. Payments made outside the platform are not protected.

steps.title: Seller ships the item
steps.description: The seller must ship the item using a trackable delivery method and provide shipment information.

steps.title: Inspect your order
steps.description: After delivery, you have 48 hours to inspect the item and report a qualifying problem.

steps.title: Order is completed
steps.description: If no problem is reported during the protection window, the order is completed and the seller becomes eligible for payment.

buyerProtection.footerText: Bid carefully. Pay securely. Inspect every delivery.

returnsPolicy.title: Returns Policy
returnsPolicy.description: Learn when an item may be returned, how to submit a return request and what happens after a return has been approved.
returnsPolicy.summary: Returns depend on the reason for the request and whether the seller is private or professional. Never return an item before receiving return instructions.

steps.title: Open your order
steps.description: Go to the relevant order in your Relora account and review its delivery and protection status.

steps.title: Report the return
steps.description: Select “Report a problem” or contact support within the applicable return or protection period.

steps.title: Wait for instructions
steps.description: Do not ship the item until you receive the return address and return instructions.

steps.title: Return with tracking
steps.description: Pack the item carefully, use trackable delivery and keep the shipping receipt until the case is completed.

returnsPolicy.footerText: Clear instructions make every return safer.

howToSell.title: How to Sell
howToSell.description: List premium and archival fashion, reach interested buyers and manage the complete auction, delivery and payout process through Relora.
howToSell.summary: Create an accurate listing, pass moderation, start your auction and ship the item with tracking after the buyer has paid.

steps.title: Create your listing
steps.description: Add clear photographs, item details, condition information, size and your starting price.

steps.title: Pass moderation
steps.description: Relora reviews the listing before it becomes available for auction.

steps.title: Start the auction
steps.description: Choose the auction duration and publish the approved item for buyers to bid on.

steps.title: Ship and get paid
steps.description: After payment, ship the item with tracking. Your payout becomes available after the order is completed.

howToSell.footerText: Ready to give your item its next owner?

sellerProtection.title: Seller Protection
sellerProtection.description: Learn how accurate listings, confirmed payments, tracked delivery and clear evidence can help protect eligible Relora sellers.
sellerProtection.summary: Ship only after confirmed payment, use the order address, provide valid tracking and keep evidence until the order and payout are completed.
summaryBullets: Tracked delivery to the order address

steps.title: Receive confirmed payment
steps.description: Do not ship until the order shows that the buyer’s payment has been successfully completed.

steps.title: Ship with tracking
steps.description: Send the item to the address shown on the order and upload valid end-to-end tracking information.

steps.title: Keep your evidence
steps.description: Save photographs of the item, packaging, shipping label and delivery receipt until the order is completed.

steps.title: Receive your payout
steps.description: Your payout may become available after delivery, the buyer inspection period and any required review.

sellerProtection.footerText: List accurately. Ship securely. Keep your evidence.

auctionRules.title: Auction Rules
auctionRules.description: Learn how Relora auctions operate, what happens when you place a bid and which responsibilities apply to winning buyers and sellers.
auctionRules.summary: Review the listing carefully before bidding. Every valid bid is binding, and the highest bidder must complete payment when the auction ends.
summaryBullets: Bids represent an obligation to buy
Winning buyers must pay on time
auctionRules.stepsTitle: From first bid to completed order

steps.title: Review the listing
steps.description: Check the photographs, description, condition, size and disclosed defects before placing a bid.

steps.title: Place your bid
steps.description: Enter an amount that meets the minimum bid requirements shown on the auction page.

steps.title: Follow the auction
steps.description: Other buyers may place higher bids until the displayed auction closing time.

steps.title: Complete the purchase
steps.description: If you are the highest bidder when the auction ends, you must complete payment within the stated deadline.

auctionRules.footerText: Review carefully. Bid responsibly. Complete every winning purchase.

sustainability.title: Better pieces deserve longer lives.
sustainability.description: Relora supports a more thoughtful approach to fashion by helping existing designer, premium and archival pieces remain visible, useful and valued.

principles.title: Resale is one part of a more thoughtful fashion system.
principles.description: We do not claim that buying or selling an item has no environmental impact. Our role is to help existing pieces stay in use for longer and to make their condition, history and value easier to understand.

sections.title: The most responsible piece can be the one that already exists.
